conventions.*_text: UTF-8 text, exact (signed notes end with LF)
conventions.expect: the AICS-1 verdict a conforming implementation reaches: valid | invalid, or a §14.6 relation
conventions.findings: README findings under which a package in this repository currently disagrees with the case: its expect, or a value it carries (in appendix-a.json: value name -> findings)
conventions.jcs: the exact RFC 8785 bytes as a UTF-8 string, no trailing LF
conventions.keys: keys.json: Ed25519 seeds are 32 repeats of one byte; X25519 secrets likewise; public test keys only
